Recognise, then adapt (S4): the opening book that turns a loaded profile into decisions for the first tick (ADAPT-1, ADAPT-2), the seeds it replays into the KNN views at a lower weight (ADAPT-3), and the trust that fades those seeds when the opponent no longer behaves like its profile (RES-4).
hadur117.core.duel - package hadur117.core.duel
 
hadur117.core.gun - package hadur117.core.gun
The duel's gun: two KNN guns, the virtual guns that rate them, and the choice between them.
hadur117.core.knn - package hadur117.core.knn
K-nearest-neighbour learning shared by the duel's gun and movement: a weighted KD-tree and the views built on it.
hadur117.core.ledger - package hadur117.core.ledger
The energy ledger: deciding which of the enemy's energy drops are bullets (WAVE-1, WAVE-2).
hadur117.core.link - package hadur117.core.link
The link (A4): teammates' reports as bytes, in the core's own versioned, checksummed format (LINK-1).
hadur117.core.melee - package hadur117.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.
hadur117.core.memory - package hadur117.core.memory
Opponent memory (stage S3): one OpponentProfile per opponent lineage, folded from each round's observations (MEM-2), encoded in a small checksummed binary format (ProfileCodec) and kept in a ProfileStore by the ProfileLibrary (MEM-1, MEM-3 to MEM-5, RES-3).
hadur117.core.model - package hadur117.core.model
The values the core is made of: what crosses the hexagonal boundary each tick, the robot states and their logs, and the waves the duel's gun and movement learn from.
hadur117.core.move - package hadur117.core.move
The duel's movement: wave surfing against the enemy's bullets, the danger views it scores with, and the shadows our own bullets cast on the enemy's waves.
hadur117.core.physics - package hadur117.core.physics
The engine's physics and the geometry built on it: the bottom layer that the duel's gun, surf, waves and energy ledger, and the melee brain, all stand on.
hadur117.core.policy - package hadur117.core.policy
Aggressive (S5): the policies that decide how close Hadur fights and how hard it shoots.
hadur117.core.port - package hadur117.core.port
The core's outbound ports: the only ways it reaches anything outside plain computation.
hadur117.core.replay - package hadur117.core.replay
Recorded battles as text, and a driver that replays them through a fresh core (CORE-2).
hadur117.core.role - package hadur117.core.role
The role contract's routing (A1 of the architecture evolution, ROLE-1 to ROLE-4): which strand drives the robot this tick.
hadur117.core.shield - package hadur117.core.shield
Bullet shielding: noticing an enemy that shoots our bullets down, and aiming so it can't.
hadur117.core.shieldmode - package hadur117.core.shieldmode
Hadur's own bullet shield (D5): on the opponents of a list of Hadur's own it opens each round sitting still and shoots the enemy's bullets down.
hadur117.core.world - package hadur117.core.world

MELEE_AIMED - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-11 (pc-melee-crowd, arm maim): off a team, a seen shot's bullets weigh 1/(1+k)^2 for the k other opponents nearer its shooter than Hadur was, and none under MinimumRiskMovement.SOFT_FLOOR: in a crowd most shots are aimed at someone else.
MELEE_BULLET_SHADE - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-20 (arm mbshade), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, each of Hadur's own bullets in flight shades the stretch of every enemy wave it crosses, from the crossing outward, as a bot shadow does (MMOVE-18's share of Hadur's width).
MELEE_CLOSER - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-14 (arm mcloser): off a team with three or more opponents left, an opponent's term is divided by one plus the number of other opponents nearer it than the point: a robot with closer prey is less likely to come for Hadur.
MELEE_CROSS - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MeleeController
MMOVE-19 (arm mcross), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, off a team, an opponent's energy loss to someone other than Hadur that one other opponent's shot explains (its damage, its wave at the victim between the victim's last two scans) teaches that shooter's aim, as a hit on Hadur does (MMOVE-15).
MELEE_HEAT - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-13 (arm mheat): off a team, an opponent Hadur is the nearest robot to is assumed to fire at Hadur on the tick its gun could next be cool (from its last seen shot, else MinimumRiskMovement.ASSUMED_FIRST_TICK) unless a real shot shows first: head-on and linear bullets at the power of its last seen shot (else MinimumRiskMovement.ASSUMED_POWER), weighing MinimumRiskMovement.ASSUMED_WEIGHT.
MELEE_HOPS - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-12 (arm mhop): off a team with three or more opponents left, short hops: the rings run from MinimumRiskMovement.HOP_INNER to MinimumRiskMovement.HOP_SHARE of the nearest fresh opponent's distance, at least MinimumRiskMovement.HOP_MIN and at most MinimumRiskMovement.RING_MAX px.
MELEE_K - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.FieldGun
MGUN-7: the kNN depth off a team.
MELEE_MIX - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-16 (arm mmix), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, a shot's share aimed at Hadur is Hadur's 1/d^2 from its source over the sum of 1/d^2 for every robot alive but the shooter, in place of MMOVE-11's 1/(1+k)^2; shares under MinimumRiskMovement.MIX_FLOOR make no bullets.
MELEE_PATH_DANGER - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-17 (arm mwpath), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, each destination of the wave check scores (20 x its wave damage / all the damage in the air + c) x (1 + c), c its risk over the risk where Hadur stands, so a crowd both adds and multiplies.
MELEE_SEARCH - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-21 (arm msearch), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, the destinations it weighs are five MinimumRiskMovement.SEARCH_STEP px steps (away from the crowd and toward the nearest corner; straight on; straight back; and square to either side) in place of the least risky points, each scored as the waves met on the way plus the least of the five steps from its end, two waves deep.
MELEE_SHADE - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-18 (arm mshade), inspired by ScalarR: with the surfer on, a wave's danger at Hadur is cut by the share of Hadur's width that another robot nearer its source covers (each robot over MinimumRiskMovement.SHADE_MIN px from the source, +-asin(18/d) wide).
MELEE_SURF - Static variable in class hadur117.core.melee.MinimumRiskMovement
MMOVE-15 (arm msurf), the melee surfer: off a team, the top three's way.
